local_metric: paired final raw score against public_greedy; higher is better
rollout_rule: at most 3 first actions; subsequent public_greedy learns simulated responses only after simulated action; positive mean and nonnegative worst paired gain required
ceiling_limit: runner-only hindsight; not a bound on full structural action space or on platform score
analysis_unit: paired seed; aggregate by graph family and keep response strata separate
production_gate: injected real LLM legal final choice validation
failure_policy: reject production promotion; retain isolated experiment evidence
constraints: no hidden seed fields in policy
no predictive writes to factual Blackboard
no credentials or raw assets committed

development_amendment_1.reason: Initial strict/bounded stress tests compared only against no-structure tails and regressed on two bridge families; current fallback can itself select a superior structural action.
development_amendment_1.comparison: max(no-structure tail, current public_greedy structural first action plus equal-resource communication tail) in each scenario
development_amendment_1.cohort: reuse development 301-303 for exploratory iteration; do not call it independent confirmation
